contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus. Probably Constantius II (323-361), possibly a copy. Reece period 18. Issue of 355-361. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. The letter B appears lower field left. Obverse inscription: (---)TIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Soldier spearing crouching barbarian –Cliff reeves kindly identified this coin; MF queries: ?fallen horseman. Obverse inscription: (---) RATIO…
